dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, this condo looks very new.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðɪs ˈkɑːndoʊ ˈlʊks ˈvɛri ˈnuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. There used to be a movie theater here. They knocked it down and built this condo last year.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛr ˈjuːst tə bi ə ˈmuːvi ˌθiːətər ˈhɪr. ðeɪ ˈnɑːkt ɪt ˈdaʊn ənd ˈbɪlt ðɪs ˈkɑːndoʊ ˈlæst ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? Why did they knock down the theater?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwaɪ dɪd ðeɪ ˈnɑːk ˈdaʊn ðə ˈθiːətər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: People didn't go there any more. Everyone watched movies at the new shopping center.
dialogue.reading: ˈpiːpəl ˈdɪdənt ˈɡoʊ ˈðɛr ˈɛni ˈmɔːr. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwɑːtʃt ˈmuːviz ət ðə ˈnuː ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˌsɛntər.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did there use to be a lot of condos on this street?
dialogue.reading: dɪd ðɛr ˈjuːs tə bi ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈkɑːndoʊz ɑːn ðɪs ˈstriːt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, there didn't use to be any. There used to be wooden houses with big gardens.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðɛr ˈdɪdənt ˈjuːs tə bi ˈɛni. ðɛr ˈjuːst tə bi ˈwʊdən ˈhaʊsɪz wɪð ˈbɪɡ ˈɡɑːrdənz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Are there any wooden houses now?
dialogue.reading: ər ðɛr ˈɛni ˈwʊdən ˈhaʊsɪz ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only a few. That old shop on the corner is one of them.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli ə ˈfjuː. ðæt ˈoʊld ˈʃɑːp ɑːn ðə ˈkɔːrnər ɪz ˈwʌn əv ðɛm.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I hope they don't knock it down, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðeɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈnɑːk ɪt ˈdaʊn, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too. There didn't use to be so many buildings here. I liked it better before.
dialogue.reading: miː ˈtuː. ðɛr ˈdɪdənt ˈjuːs tə bi ˈsoʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɪldɪŋz ˈhɪr. aɪ ˈlaɪkt ɪt ˈbɛtər bɪˈfɔːr.
